decisions.source_evidence: 0-1 line 1 (עַל־כֵּן נְקַוֶּה לְּךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ): the tsere dots under ה sit in a dense run of hataf-segol, holam and tsere marks. I can't separate a vertical stroke from them at this enlargement.
0-0 line 1: there may be a mark beside the segol under א, but I can't tell a stroke from the segol dots and nearby ink.
0-0 line 1, end of line: the qubuts and segol are visible. A possible tick next to the segol under ז is not clearly separate.
0-1 line 2: under הָאָ there are two qamats marks, then a separate short vertical stroke after the second, then the segol under ר.
0-0 line 3 (יִקְרְאוּ בִשְׁמֶךָ): there is ink near the segol under מ, but I can't confirm a separate vertical stroke.
0-1 / 1-1 line start (אֵלֶיךָ כָּל־רִשְׁעֵי אָרֶץ): the marks under אֵלֶ are crowded. A stroke beside the segol is possible but not clearly distinct.
0-1 / 1-1 line 1: under א there is a qamats with a short vertical stroke right after it, before the segol under ר. It looks the same as the stroke in id 3.
1-1 line 1, end: the patah under י is clear. Next to the hiriq dot under כּ there may be a short stroke, but it is too small to confirm.
1-1 line 2 (תִּכְרַע כָּל־בֶּרֶךְ): a short vertical stroke stands between the segol under בּ and the segol under ר.
1-0 line 2 (לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ): there seems to be something after the segol under נ, but the yod and final-kaf qamats sit close by. It isn't conclusive.
1-0 line 2: same crowded run of marks as id 0. I can't isolate a stroke.
1-0 line 3 (יְקָר יִתֵּנוּ): there may be a tick beside the tsere under תּ. I can't resolve it.
1-1 line 4, start: the patah and shva are clear. Near the segol under ת I can't tell a stroke from the segol dots.
2-1 line 3 (יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ): a short vertical stroke follows the segol under מ, before the segol under ל.
2-1 line 3: same pattern as id 3, two qamats then a separate vertical stroke, then the segol.
3-1 line 1 / 3-0 line 1: the patah and shva are clear. Beside the hiriq under נ there may be a stroke, but the shva and dot are too close to tell.
3-0 line 1: I see the tsere under זּ, but no clearly separate stroke. The printed letters and vowels match the target.
3-0 line 1: after the qamats under ה, a short vertical stroke stands beside the hiriq under ר.
3-0 line 2: a qamats under נ with a short vertical stroke beside it, then the segol under ב.
3-0 line 2 (תִּקְעוּ בַחֹדֶשׁ): the holam is a dot above, so a meteg under ח would stand alone. There is a faint mark there, but I can't tell it from a smudge.
3-0 line 2, end of line: the segols under כּ and ס are visible. A possible stroke between them is not clearly resolved at the edge of the line.
3-1 line 3 (לְיוֹם חַגֵּנוּ): the patah is clear. A stroke beside the tsere under גּ is not distinct.
3-1 line 4: a short vertical stroke stands after the segol under א, before the segol under ר.
3-1 line 4: a qamats under ר followed by a short vertical stroke, then the hiriq under י.
3-0 line 4: the qamats under י and the patah under ד are visible. A stroke next to the patah is possible but not separable.
3-0 line 4, end of line: tsere under סּ. I can't confirm a separate stroke.
3-1 line 6: under ב there may be a mark before the shva under ר, but it isn't clearly a meteg.
3-0 line 5 / 4-0 line 1: the second qamats, under ר, has a short vertical stroke beside it.
3-0 line 5 / 4-0 line 1: there is a dense run of marks under the word. I can't isolate a stroke beside the segol under צ.
3-0 line 5, end of line: tsere under ס, possibly with a tick, but not resolved.
3-1 line 7, start: two patah marks. A stroke next to the first is suggested but not clearly separate from the patah bar.
3-1 line 7 end / 4-0 line 2 start / 4-1 line 2 end: a short vertical stroke beside the segol under ס, before the qamats under ל. I saw it in more than one panel.
4-0 line 2: the qamats under א is clear. Beside the hiriq under ע there may be a stroke, but it is not clearly resolved.
4-1 line 4 (יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ): crowded marks. A stroke after the segol under ה is not distinct.
4-1 line 4: a short vertical stroke between the segol under א and the segol under ר.
4-0 line 4 start: a qamats under ר with a short vertical stroke beside it, then the hiriq.
4-0 line 4: tsere under the second א. I can't separate a stroke.
4-0 line 6 / 4-1 line 6 end: tsere under מ, then the furtive patah. I can't confirm a separate stroke.
4-0 line 6: tsere under לּ, no resolvable stroke.
4-1 line 7 / 5-1 line 1: the patah and shva are clear. A stroke beside the hiriq under נ is not distinct.
5-1 line 2: tsere under ל. I can't isolate a stroke.
5-1 line 2: tsere under מ and under ח. There may be a mark beside the second, but it isn't conclusive.
5-0 line 2: segol under ע. A possible stroke before the final kaf is not clearly separate.
